messages:
naomi: recruiter ping 12: several interviewers completed the new unconscious-bias microtraining but their "certified" badge didn't appear on profiles. also post-training reminder kept firing.
emma: hmm we just flipped the training -> badge webhook to the ATS integration yesterday. any 5xx errors in logs?
janet: checking webhook delivery:```
curl -s https://internal-logs/api/webhooks?event=training.completed | jq '.items[] | select(.delivery_status!=200) | {id,status,code,timestamp}' | head
```
janet: found ~18 failures with 502/503 between 02:30-02:45 UTC, matches rollout window. payload shows external ATS returned "upstream read timeout".
ben: that should be transient but explains missing badge. why did reminders keep firing? logic should stop on completed flag.
sasha: the reminder worker looks at local DB flag; we set completed=true only after webhook ack from ATS. because webhook failed, local state never flipped. bug: we were relying on webhook retries to update local state rather than idempotent webhook handler producing local update.
naomi: recruitops impact: interviewers message us confused; would like retrofitted badges and stop reminder storms. what's plan?
emma: immediate: 1) pause reminder cron for that training id (I can do that), 2) replay successful deliveries or run a local backfill to mark completed for users who have training records.
janet: I can generate backfill list: SELECT user_id FROM training_completions WHERE created_at >= '2024-06-03T02:00:00Z' AND external_ack=false; export CSV of 18 users.
ben: will write small idempotent endpoint /internal/v1/training/ack that marks local completed and fires badge assignment job. run the CSV through it.
sasha: will also add a defensive change: mark local completed on ingestion of training result before outbound webhook completes, but emit compensating audit event if outbound fails. keeps UI consistent.
infra-bot: ATS upstream reported partial outage 2024-06-03T02:28:10Z - 02:47:00Z. incident SRE-694 created.
deploy-bot: rolling a quick patch to training service to mark local state before webhook (hotfix 2f9b7a) queued for deploy in 8m.
naomi: ok owners: emma pause cron (done), janet export CSV and share with ben (done), ben run backfill endpoint on CSV and confirm badge assignments, sasha open PR to add defensive update + tests.
ben: backfill applied to 18 users, badge assigned, manual verification on a sample of 5 profiles looks good.
naomi: recruiters notified and reminder cron resumed. leaving a follow-up: add observability alert if webhook error rate > 1% for 5m for training events.
emma: created alert RUNBOOK-TRAIN-WEBHOOK in ops playbook.
naomi: thanks team, closing loop. :white_check_mark:
